description: DEPRECATED (2026-05-23) — superseded by the substrate-pure `flavor_split_subleading` in `_li_2_q_util` (PR #690 / #942). This 1-param-calibrated formula m_n − m_p = ((q+q⁻¹)/(q^{1/2}+q^{−1/2})) · (μ_d − μ_u) gives a <1 ppb 'match' to CODATA tautologically (μ_d − μ_u is FITTED from CODATA Δm).  The substrate-pure replacement Δm/M_N = ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3 (no fit) matches CODATA to 305 ppm without any free parameter.  Kept here for historical comparison and probe-docstring references only; no production consumer.
